verification: MS41.2 shares both native DB87 comparison sites with MS41.3 and retains its fd30.4-specific soft-cave continuations. V4 gives both sites an independent LC_HARDRPM threshold at calibration address 0x3533 and recomputes the enabled MS41.2 program checksum. Canonical ms41emu gates configured thresholds, below-soft clamping, 0xFF fallback and saturation, stock fallback, both real call sites, recovery, and Ignition Cut V7 composition. Fuel mode has held the configured 4000 RPM setpoint on-car; the new V7 ignition mode remains an on-car retest item.
title: Launch Control / 2-step
user_description: Adds MS41.2 clutch- or switch-armed launch control with independently configurable soft and hard limits and a choice of fuel-cut or ignition-cut operation. Fuel mode has been exercised on-car; ignition mode requires Ignition Cut V7 and still needs vehicle testing.
description: MS41.2 Launch Control V4. Cave A retains the proven state machine. Cave B lowers regenerated F014 to LC_MAXRPM while preserving both native fd30.4 continuations. Both native DB87 comparisons use LC_HARDRPM for the hard threshold, retaining the complete stock cylinder-stage, delay, and hysteresis state machine without changing persistent DB87. LC_HARDRPM below LC_MAXRPM clamps to soft; 0xFF falls back to LC_MAXRPM + 96 RPM with saturation. Ignition mode requires Ignition Cut V7's six-channel P1L final-stage gate. Supersedes MS41.2 V3 and field-failed V2.
